key_insight: HAVAPlot enables browser-only scientific visualization and post-processing of simulation data without software installation or data uploads.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can inspect native OpenFOAM, VTK, and tabular datasets locally and export publication-ready plots across diverse flow applications.
method: Read native OpenFOAM meshes, fields, boundaries, and particles alongside VTK and tabular data.
Apply exact polyhedral slicing, variable calculations, streamlines, isosurfaces, and particle visualization.
Verify mesh geometry, field reading, and interpolation against independent implementations and analytical fields.
evidence_signal: Verification reproduced 6.1 million field values to machine precision across four production cases, demonstrated second-order interior and first-order boundary interpolation convergence, and loaded 250,000-cell meshes in at most 1.3 seconds.
watch_item: Browser memory limits and performance on meshes substantially larger than the reported 250,000-cell benchmark remain to be established.
paper_title: HAVAPlot: A Web-Based Scientific Visualization and Post-Processing Platform
